title: ★★★★★ Unforgettable flamenco night
text:
I went to Casa de la Memoria with my love, and it was absolutely amazing. Every part of the performance was incredible: the guitar, the singing, the dancing, the stamping feet. You could feel it in your body from the first note to the last.

The venue is intimate, so you're close enough to see the passion on the performers' faces. It felt raw and real, nothing like a tourist show, and it was a perfect evening to share with someone special.

Highly recommended. Book ahead and sit as close as you can.
author: Tanya_D

title: Very good introduction to flamenco
text: Loved the intimate environment.  It felt like the early days of flamenco in someone’s home, with informal but enthusiastic discussions and singing by our hosts. The male flamenco dancer was astonishing.  I think I had my mouth open the whole time he was dancing.  Unbelievable complexity to the rhythm and movements.
author: Pennymohr

title: Passionate performance

title: Talented dancers, passionate experience!
